  Allocation (PLHA), to the meeting of Wednesday, June 25, 2025.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, presented the staff report.

  Mayor De Paula closed the Public Hearing.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to continue the
  hearing to the City Council meeting of Wednesday, June 25, 2025.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Farfan, Roa, Vargas, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Del Rio
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to receive and file the update on the City of Hawaiian Gardens' submitted SCAG
  STBG grant, and to approve Willdan Engineering’s proposal in the amount of $100,160 for the
  provision of engineering design and federal grant administration services for the Citywide Surface
  Transportation Block Grant Project.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, presented the staff report.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  RECUSE: 0;

D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the Summer Program
starts June 2, 2025, announced Lee Ware Park Pool hours and days for kids camp and that both
registrations are full. Summer kick­off Pool Party will be held on May 31, 2025.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that a gun buyback event will be held on May 30, 2025.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced that a community block cleanup will be held on
June 14, 2025; and a tire recycle event will be held on June 14, 2025.

There were no Oral City Attorney Reports.

There were no Oral Council Reports.

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, read the Closed Session items into the record.

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 6:17 PM.

  The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at 8:49 PM.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, conducted a roll call and announced a quorum.

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, stated no reportable action was taken, direction was given,
  from Closed Session.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

on Wednesday, June 11, 2025 at 6:00 PM
